name: To Thunder Bluff

meta.previous: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit (Horde)

summary: To Thunder Bluff marks the triumphant return of a young tauren druid from their communion with the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade. Having earned the favor of the Great Cat Spirit, the initiate returns to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise to master the art of feline shapeshifting.

sections.title: Return from Moonglade
sections.body: After proving their insight and worth before Dendrite Starblaze and the Great Cat Spirit in the sacred groves of Moonglade, a young druid must carry the spirit's blessings back to Mulgore. The communion with such primal powers represents a pivotal milestone in a druid's training, bridging ancient night elven teachings with the tauren's own earthen heritage.

sections.title: Mastering the Cat Form
sections.body: Awaiting your return high atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff is Turak Runetotem. While Dendrite facilitated communion with the spirit itself, it falls to Turak to guide the physical transformation. With the blessing of the Great Cat Spirit acknowledged, the elder trainer imparts the sacred knowledge required to adopt the swift, predatory shape of the cat.

faq.q: Where does this quest begin and end?
aliases: where do i turn this in
to thunder bluff quest turn in
faq.answer: The quest is given by Dendrite Starblaze in the sacred haven of Moonglade. It directs the traveler back to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff to speak with Turak Runetotem.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what do i get from to thunder bluff
faq.answer: It serves as the concluding transition in the druid trial of the cat. After receiving the blessing of the Great Cat Spirit in Moonglade, the initiate must return to their mentor in Thunder Bluff to finally learn how to assume Cat Form.

Turak Runetotem is a respected elder of the tauren druids stationed on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff. He oversees the training and initiation of young Horde druids seeking to harmonize with nature and master their shapeshifting forms.

Dendrite Starblaze is a night elf keeper of the Cenarion Circle who guides visiting druids in Nighthaven within Moonglade. He bridges instruction between ancient kaldorei traditions and tauren practitioners regardless of factional tensions.

faq.q: What is the Great Cat Spirit?
faq.answer: The Great Cat Spirit is an ancient, primal entity revered by druids, embodying predatory instinct, stealth, and agility. Every druid seeking to take the feline form must pass a trial to earn its blessing and understand its dual nature as both playful and deadly.

faq.q: Do Alliance druids have an equivalent task?
aliases: alliance version of to thunder bluff
faq.answer: Yes. Night elf druids undergo a parallel rite in Moonglade, returning to Darnassus to report to their own mentor rather than heading to the wind-swept mesas of Mulgore.

angles.text: This rite represents the unlocking of your predatory instincts, granting mastery over stealth and claws as taught by Turak Runetotem.
The journey underscores the tauren reconnection to Cenarion traditions, carrying lessons from sacred Moonglade back to the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
Though the Cenarion Circle remains neutral, Horde druids must return to their capital to ensure their growing power serves the defense of their kin.
